infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Receipts uses Face ID to protect your private journal entries with biometric authentication.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Receipts uses your camera to attach photos and optionally read visible text (on-device) into your entry notes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Receipts accesses your photo library so you can attach images to journal entries.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Receipts uses your location to automatically tag where a journal entry was written.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Receipts uses the microphone to record voice memos you attach to journal entries.
